text:
Clara (Design): dropping a new prototype for a compact scorecard row view for prompt-evals. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc987/compact-scorecard?node-id=2%3A4
Clara (Design): goal: make regression diffs scannable in a dense list for power users, while keeping single-action affordances (inline approve, view diff, flag). thinking condensed row with hover-expansion for full outputs.
Ravi (Product): love the dense approach for heavy reviewers. Q: how do we surface token-level scoring without clutter?
Clara (Design): show a tiny sparkline + overall quality pill on the row, and move token breakdown into the expandable panel or a side drawer.
Jon (Frontend): implementation notes 14: we'll use a virtualized list (react-window) with expandable row heights. inline buttons must be non-blocking for row click — use separate action buttons (icon-only) so selection and expand don't conflict.
Marta (A11y): accessible row pattern: make each row a <button> with aria-expanded, but icon actions should be real buttons. ensure row role="listitem" and the list has role="list". keyboard: Enter toggles expand, Space toggles selection.
Theo (UX Research): in our last study, reviewers tested much faster when they could approve from the list vs opening a modal. recommend keeping approve inline but require an undo toast.
Clara (Design): inline approve icon will be a check circle. clicking it triggers a small inline confirmation ("Approve this run?") to avoid accidental taps on touch. if confirmed, show toast with Undo.
Jon (Frontend): quick code sketch: 
```jsx
// pseudo
<Row role="listitem" tabIndex={0} aria-expanded={expanded}>
  <Checkbox onKeyDown={handleSpaceSelect}/>
  <Summary />
  <IconButton aria-label="Approve run" onClick={handleApprove}/>
  <Expander hidden={!expanded}><DiffPreview/></Expander>
</Row>
```
Marta (A11y): please ensure the approve IconButton has aria-pressed when toggled and that toasts use role="status" or role="alert" depending on urgency. also color contrast: current green check on white is failing for 12px icons.
ci-bot: accessibility/lint results for branch feat/compact-scorecard: 
```
axe: color-contrast (ApproveIcon) 1: contrast 2.2:1 against white
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Jon (Frontend): will swap the icon color to a darker green and wrap row summary in a <button> to fix the lint. also will implement focus-visible ring and live region for toasts.
Ravi (Product): copy: instead of "Approve" let's use "Accept output" in the inline controls. for bulk we should label "Accept selected runs". Also change badge copy from "regressed" to "degraded quality"? open to phrasing.
Theo (UX Research): "degraded quality" tested less emotionally than "regressed". users responded better to neutral language during reviews.
Marta (A11y): microcopy: when announcing changes via screen reader, include context: "Run accepted. Undo" rather than only "Accepted". the toast action must be keyboard-focusable.
Clara (Design): updated microcopy noted. also adding a severity filter ("High/Med/Low") as a small dropdown and a keyboard shortcut (Shift+F) to open filters.
Jon (Frontend): adding shortcut sounds good. will need to coordinate with global shortcuts package. also will record a 20s screen capture showing keyboard navigation and upload to the PR.
Theo (UX Research): can we add a tiny inline diff indicator (small colored bar) that shows direction (improved/worse) and magnitude? users liked the visual cue in testing. ensure we don't rely only on color (add chevrons +/-).
Marta (A11y): yes, include aria-labels like "quality increased by 3%". and provide text alternatives for color-only indicators.
Clara (Design): final: I'll push a compact variant and an expanded-row variant in figma. aiming to ship prototype for internal testing next week.
Jon (Frontend): I'll address the ci errors, tweak contrast, and send PR with a11y checklist ticked off.
ci-bot: note: please add axe baseline test for /evals routes in CI to prevent regressions.
Ravi (Product): great work. leaving thread open for final a11y or copy tweaks. thanks all :tada:
